remarks: Stunning 2 bedroom/2.5 bathroom apartment completely renovated from top to bottom at the Park Tower Stamford! Enter into this 1,684 sq ft open floor plan masterpiece with luxury plank flooring throughout. Chef's kitchen contains a magnificent quartz waterfall island with Chapman & Myers pendants, stainless steel Viking appliances and white shaker kitchen cabinets with built-in drawer inserts. Dining room includes a dazzling Jonathan Browning fontanelle linear chandelier. Generously sized bedrooms with motorized blackout shades. All bathrooms appointed with polished european porcelain tiling along with modern Kohler commodes and Loire lighting fixtures. Primary bathroom equipped with a luxurious Oceania two-person Chilko 64 jetted tub.  Take time to enjoy great weather on your own private balcony with outdoor wood tile flooring. Building amenities include indoor pool, fitness room, rooftop terrace with views of Manhattan and a shuttle service to and from Metro North. Easy access to restaurants, shops, entertainment options and I-95. Pack your bags and move in tomorrow!
